flags.message: The snapshot records an August 25, 2026 merits brief by the Court-appointed amicus defending Stinson and the judgment below, but documents.json contains no corresponding brief. Both provisioned party briefs support vacatur. The complete argument transcript includes the appointed amicus's presentation, which I used to assess the affirmance position; prediction is not blocked. Provisioning the appointed defender's brief would improve balance in this posture.
